description: Files an issue on the Nerviz repository from inside a generated project, from a free description or from a lessons-learned file under `docs/lessons-learned/`. Picks the repository's own issue form, refuses a report with no evidence a maintainer can verify, warns when the project is behind the latest release, searches open duplicates, strips everything that identifies this project, and publishes only after an explicit confirmation. Explicit invocation only.
